name: general
audience: curious people scrolling; no prior knowledge
tone: warm, surprising, concrete; one mechanism + one surprising detail
rules: History topics: say what is known vs debated; no invented quotes or dates.
Science topics: one mechanism, explained with a picture for every sentence.
No Sonar mention in general episodes for now.
Edu 2026-10-26: visuals must look realistic and detailed (3D: src/three/), not flat diagrams; reference = Keyframes reels.
Edu 2026-10-26: hooks need stakes + a picture in the first second (see script-guide 'Hooks'); never 'Have you ever wondered…'.
caption_format: Line 1: the hook as a question or surprising fact.
Follow @sonartracker.io for one 'how does that work?' every week.
Then a 'Sources:' block for the first comment.
